summary: Asure Software filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $115 million senior credit facility with MUFG as administrative agent, dated October 15, 2026. The facility comprises an $85.0 million term loan fully drawn at closing, a $10.0 million five-year revolver, and a $20.0 million delayed-draw term loan, plus a $30 million accordion. Amortization begins April 1, 2027, at 2.5% rising to 7.5% annually, maturing October 15, 2031. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; watch covenant headroom and leverage.
